summary: Churchill Capital Corp XIII, a blank-check company, filed an 8-K reporting the consummation of its initial public offering on August 3, 2026. The company sold 41,400,000 units at $10.00 per unit, including 5,400,000 units from the underwriter's full over-allotment exercise, generating gross proceeds of $414 million. Each unit comprises one Class A ordinary share and one-tenth of a redeemable warrant exercisable at $11.50 per share. The filing also covers related agreements, unregistered securities, director departures/appointments, and charter amendments. This is a routine SPAC IPO disclosure, not a special situation; no actionable deal terms or risk-arb angle exist.
